summary.text: Gloria Johnson is a Democratic state representative from Tennessee House District 90, a former special education teacher who served in the House from 2012 to 2014 and again since 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gloria Johnson earned a bachelor's degree in special education and teaching from the University of Tennessee in 1986.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a consultant with Change Driven Strategies, a caregiver with Seniors Helping Seniors, and a special education teacher at Central High School in Fountain City.
She has served as chair of the Knox County Democratic Party and as a board member of Emerge TN and the TN Women's Political Caucus.
Johnson previously represented Tennessee House District 13 from 2012 to 2014, and she assumed office in District 90 on November 8, 2022.
Ballotpedia notes that on April 6, 2023, the Tennessee House of Representatives failed to pass House resolution 64 to expel her.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists her on the Criminal Justice, Education Instruction and Insurance committees.
